# Welcome to Discussions

Use Discussions for questions, learning stories, resource ideas, and community conversation that does not belong in an issue.

Before posting, search existing discussions and read the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Please avoid sharing credentials, private contact details, or promotional links unrelated to the project.

When asking for help, include what you tried, the relevant file or link, and the smallest question that would unblock you.
